slides.headline: Leaving England forever. Look at her hand.
slides.sub: Ford Madox Brown, The Last of England, 1852-55

slides.headline: Thousands leave England each year. This couple is leaving *forever*.
He stares ahead, jaw clenched, almost *angry*.
She looks straight at us, pale and *silent*.
Look inside her cloak. She holds a tiny *hand*.
Below the cloak, their hands are clasped *tightly*.
A black umbrella shields them from the cold *spray*.
Behind them, a man shakes his fist at the *shore*.
In the crowd, a little girl eats, too young to *understand*.
Far behind, the white cliffs of England slowly *fade*.
Brown painted himself and his wife Emma as the *couple*.
Leave everything for a better life? Would *you* board that ship?
